summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (September 20, 2022) reporting new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 4a ("New Privately-Owned Housing Units Under Construction at End of Period") provides seasonally adjusted monthly data for the United States, specifically detailing values for "1 unit" (single-family) and "5 units or more" buildings. For August 2022, the table lists 812,000 single-family units and 873,000 units in buildings with five or more. This document contributes the initial seasonally adjusted figures required to evaluate the "more than double" condition for the start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. Note that this data is marked preliminary and subsequent reports in the collection may provide revised values for this month.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, September 2022" (Release Number: CB22-174, dated October 19, 2022). Relevant to the task: It includes Table 4a ("New Privately-Owned Housing Units Under Construction at End of Period"), which provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates for units under construction categorized by unit type ("1 unit" and "5 units or more"). The document supplies specific data values for August 2022 (revised: 809,000 single-family; 876,000 five or more) and September 2022 (preliminary: 800,000 single-family; 893,000 five or more) required to evaluate the task's condition for the start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 window. It does not, however, contain data for any months after September 2022, leaving the remainder of the requested timeframe unrepresented in this file.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release (Release Number CB22-191) detailing New Residential Construction for October 2022, dated November 17, 2022. Relevant to the task, Table 4a provides seasonally adjusted "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Under Construction at End of Period" for the United States, specifically distinguishing between "1 unit" (single-family) and "5 units or more" (multi-family). This document contains revised data for August and September 2022, and preliminary data for October 2022, serving as the most recent source for these months per the task's instruction that later reports prevail. It supplies the specific unit counts (in thousands) necessary to evaluate the "more than double" condition for these months: October 2022 (794k single-family, 910k 5+ units), September 2022 (798k single-family, 892k 5+ units), and August 2022 (808k single-family, 877k 5+ units).
